messages:
emily.sales: kicking off Novus pilot — they want a short POC (2 weeks) with Hosted API + an optional Dedicated burst. Need billing project, ~$8k seed credits, spend cap + ephemeral keys. Who can provision? :wave:
raj.se: @emily.sales quick q — will they need VPC/Private or just Hosted for first week? Also expected peak RPS?
emily.sales: Hosted for first week, if perf looks good they want to try Dedicated pool (small burst, 2x A100). Peak tbd but planning ~200 rps at 512 tokens.
maria.billing: I can do the project seed. For Hosted POC we usually seed up to $10k credits. We need billing contact + billing address and whether invoice or card. I can also set a hard spend cap on the project.
emia.sales: (typo) updated — emily.sales: billing contact is julia@novus.ai, prefer card on file for now. Address TBD, I'll send details in DM.
maria.billing: ok — I'll create project and apply credits once I have contact email. Proposed defaults: credits=8000, daily_spend_cap=1000, token_quota=unlimited (but can set per-route). If you want token quota, say how much.
sophia.sec: for Dedicated/VPC gating we'll need completed security checklist + CIDR for peering. If they move to Private later, SOC2 doc + data handling answers required. I'll DM the questionnaire.
emily.sales: will collect CIDR from customer, they asked about ephemeral keys TTL — what's standard?
aaron.ops: we issue ephemeral API keys for POC with a 72h TTL by default. Rotation flow: devs request via UI or API, returns `ephemeral_key` and `expires_at`. Example curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION" -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/keys/ephemeral -d '{"project":"proj_novus_poc","ttl":259200}'``` Use `--ttl` seconds. For Dedicated pool we need capacity ticket (infra ticket ID) to reserve GPUs — link: https://internal/infra/tickets/INF-3245 (cc @raj.se).
maria.billing: starting the project now, I'll post confirmation. Charge method=card, seed=8000, spend_cap=1000/day.
provision-bot: billing project created: id=proj_novus_9f3a, owner=julia@novus.ai, credits=8000, spend_cap=1000/day (created_by=maria.billing) :white_check_mark:
maria.billing: @emily.sales please confirm billing address and whether we should enable automated overage alerts to the account owner.
emily.sales: confirm enable alerts. I'll DM the address now.
sophia.sec: added sec checklist for Novus to your drive, request Slack DM when they complete. Also note: if they request Private/VPC we block export of logs to public buckets until approved.
raj.se: note on Dedicated burst — capacity lead time ~48-72h after ticket approval. If they want same-day testing, we can simulate load on Hosted with a higher concurrency profile.
emily.sales: great — thx everyone. I'll follow up after I get CIDR + billing address. :thumbsup:
provision-bot: ephemeral keys enabled for project proj_novus_9f3a, default_ttl=259200s (72h).
